name: Os Peroneum Syndrome
definition: Painful disorder involving the os peroneum within the peroneus longus tendon, including fracture, diastasis, stress reaction or tendon tear.

investigations.principle: Radiographs, ultrasound and MRI help identify ossicle fracture and tendon pathology.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Displaced fracture or tendon rupture may require surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-Snayu/Asthi accessory phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Painful disorder involving the os peroneum within the peroneus longus tendon, including fracture, diastasis, stress reaction or tendon tear.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
